english.title: Disclose confidential information obtained in exercise of power to enter and search designated high street / town centre
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), disclosed

(A)_[information which constituted a trade secret]_
(B)_[information, the disclosure of which would or would be likely to prejudice the commercial interests of a person]_

and which was obtained in the exercise of a power conferred by section 211(2) of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023, for purposes other than those for which the power was exercised
english.legislation: Contrary to section 212(3) and (4) of the Levelling-up and Regeneration Act 2023.
